notes: LAMOST-HVS1: Included as a follow-up of the previously discovered nearby HVS candidate that this paper analyzes. The paper's adopted HVS definition at T:p2-b2 is ejection from the Galactic Center rather than an explicit present-day Galactic-boundness criterion; eligibility here rests on the prior HVS-candidate identification (T:p4-b7, T:p4-b11). The note at T:p11-b5 reports that Gaia DR2 instead favored a disk hyper-runaway origin, which under follow_up does not remove eligibility. The paper provides no Gaia source ID.

LAMOST-HVS1: Table 1 reports expected Gaia errors rather than a measured parallax or measured proper-motion components, so no parallax or proper-motion values are extracted. The distance modulus and heliocentric distance are alternative reported distance measures. Section 5.5 (T:p11-b5) later states that LAMOST-HVS1 is a hyper-runaway star rather than a Galactic Center HVS; this does not change the tabulated observed/estimated quantities, but it affects the interpretation of the Galactic-origin mock predictions. Relevant locations: T:p4-b11, T:p5-b0, T:p8-b10, T:p11-b5.
